post.description: rma (returned/faulty or lost) and retire both kill the camera's key. A reason is required and audited.

get.description: Who can do what, right now: the evidence an auditor asks for.

Who can be picked in a drop-down. tasks: yourself, your department if you are its head, everyone for the President.
tickets: active staff who can actually work tickets (hold support.write).

post.description: The President issues a one-time face-enrollment code (shown once) for a face-required account.

get.description: The home page. Each block appears only if the person holds the right for it, so nobody sees another department's numbers.
Public. The app calls this on start: force-update gate, maintenance notice, feature flags.

post.description: Enroll the President's face. Allowed with a one-time code (printed by the CLI) or after a fresh face check (re-enrollment).
Live face check. Used to finish sign-in and to re-confirm before sensitive actions. Every attempt is recorded.
The owner clears a lock. The camera enters a service window so it can be fixed, then must be armed again.

get.description: Everything we hold about this customer except the raw face vectors (data portability).
A short-lived signed link to one of the caller's pictures, for image views and notification attachments.
Snapshots are served only to the customer that owns them.

post.description: First boot: swap the code printed on the box for a device key (shown once, stored only as a hash).
The camera's own sensors (accelerometer wake, reed switch) report immediately instead of waiting for the next check-in.
